items.title: Vertiv Bets $2.6 Billion on Grid, Microgrid Solutions for AI Data Centers
items.summary: Vertiv Holdings Co (NYSE:VRT) on Wednesday said its wholly owned subsidiary plans to acquire Utility Innovation Holdings. The consideration includes approximately $1.45 billion in cash at closing, plus up to $1.15 billion based on EBITDA targets over 12- and 24-month periods. The upfront price represents about 13x expected UIG 2027 EBITDA, with a significantly lower multiple if the full earnout is paid.
